rows.title: Revenue boom has CT officials rethinking budget timetable
rows.standfirst: If CT lawmakers had known earlier about projected big budget numbers, they might have done things differently in this short session.

rows.title: CT House to put last ARPA funds toward higher ed, other programs
rows.standfirst: The House was expected to assign at least $360 million to bolster higher education, social services, mental health, municipal aid and more

rows.title: CT legislature passes $370M budget stabilization plan
rows.standfirst: Higher education and human services in CT get a temporary boost under the plan, but Republicans say budget rules were ignored.

rows.title: CT $4.4B bond bill includes UConn construction, anti-poverty program
rows.standfirst: The package would boost borrowing for capital projects, launch a seven-year UConn building initiative and combat poverty and homelessness.

rows.title: Five reasons why CT’s strange budget journey won’t repeat itself
rows.standfirst: Supporters and critics of the new CT budget concede the path taken to craft the plan was unconventional — and it won’t happen again.

rows.title: Lawmakers OK one-time spend-down of transportation reserves
rows.standfirst: With CT’s transportation program on pace to leave money unspent again, Lamont had hoped to stave off gas-tax critics by paying down debt.
